versions.changelog:
- Added an output-envelope schema and utilities for output formatting, time handling, and URL validation.
- Reworked the skill guide with clearer execution prerequisites, command selection, parameter reference, and URL-type guidance.
- Expanded examples and usage guidance, including account metrics, content filters, and query limits.
- Updated skill metadata and removed the listed legacy files.

- Initial release of douyin-content-insights skill.
- Fetch Douyin KOL profile info and content lists in real time via Guaikei API (up to 10,000 items).
- Supports: keyword search (with filters), creator post scraping, video/text comment collection, and real-time trending list retrieval.
- Outputs structured JSON with author, engagement data, tags, and links.
- Intended for Douyin content search, competitor/account monitoring, topic research, comment/opinion analysis, and trend tracking.
- Triggered by keywords such as 抖音搜索, 抖音热榜, 抖音评论, 抖音作品, 竞品分析, 短视频运营, etc.
